title: Redact
statement: Implement `solve(fields)`. `fields` is a dict. Drop the keys `password`, `token`, and `secret` if present. Return the remaining dict. Do not modify values of other keys.
constraints: Those three names are the secret keys
Other keys stay, including authorization if it is not in the list
hints: Delete the three names when they exist.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A log line of the request body will include a password if you log the dict you were given.

editorial: A log line of the request body will include a password if you log the dict you were given. Deleting the known secret keys before formatting is the minimum redact. It is not a full DLP pass. The copy protects the caller's mapping.
